description: The SEMANTICS faculty (associative_recall — the agent's own shape verdict), graph-native. When a recognised mark points at the candidate it was recognised as (recognised_as edge, stamped by the world adapter = the recognition result), this Rule COMPLETES the form to its MEANING: it get-or-creates ONE canonical meaning Concept by name (add_node_if_absent, dedup by name = autoassociative attractor — every instance of a character recalls the SAME concept) and binds the mark to it (denotes). No Python decision; the binding IS the Rule.
